scope: topological counterexample at a closed attached slit
reproduction: Plus/minus V-paths both converge uniformly to a slit-touching path, but their equal mixture avoids with probability 1/2 at every n and 0 at the limit.

scope: conditioning of a finite fugacity SAW collection on a prescribed length
reproduction: All paths at length n have common weight x^n; the rare-length atom example shows weak joint convergence cannot identify that conditional law.
unresolved_gap: Uniform relative local-limit estimate and free-endpoint/domain transfer absent.

scope: finite nonempty path collection and x>0
reproduction: On L=n every path has the same weight x^n, so the conditional law is uniform within the original endpoint/domain constraints.
unresolved_gap: No removal of endpoints or finite domain, and no scaling transfer.
